content.text:
The quest The Pale Harvest is finished. I picked the lock on the captain's strongbox without fighting, took the Kothringi Keystone, and brought it to Nesh-Deeka. She paid me 100 gold.

She didn't recognise the keystone but says the carving is Kothringi. Her next lead is the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, in the Tulmek Washes, whose elder keeps what's left of Kothringi lore.

She says the Unbound haven't found the wreck. When I wondered how she knew, she only said "we listen." I still don't know what the keystone opens.

I've given the game my closing notes, and it has ended.
